name: io.github.jonathanrreed/apple-mail-mcp
title: Apple Mail
description: Read, search, compose, and send emails via Apple Mail on macOS.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MAIL_MCP_SAFETY_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Safety mode for Mail operations: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MAIL_MCP_ALLOWED_ATTACHMENT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Directory attachments may be saved to or attached from. Unset disables attachment file access.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MAIL_MCP_VISIBLE_DRAFTS
environmentVariables.description: Whether compose tools open visible draft windows in Mail.app.
